description: This file defines a utility class `EntityTypeUtil` providing helper methods for handling entity types within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for checking type hierarchies, retrieving descendants and ancestors, and verifying parent type relationships.

classes.name: EntityTypeUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to work with entity type hierarchies, such as checking if a type is related to another, retrieving descendants, and verifying parent relationships.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Checks if a collection of entities contains a type related to the target type through a specified relationship.

methods.name: getParentType
methods.description: Retrieves the parent type of a given type value, based on a naming convention.

methods.name: getDescendantTypes
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all descendant types of a given type value.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Determines if a type value is of a specific target type by traversing the hierarchy.

methods.name: hasParentType
methods.description: Checks whether a specific type has a designated parent type by querying the entity data.
